Class JVMud

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.JVMud
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class JVMud extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Application hub owning mudlib lifetimes and transport components. Each mudlib owns its clock and execution queue; no engine tick visits all worlds. Connections choose a mudlib before any player or persona is created.
